findingDetails.title: The doctor README still says a single-quoted or trailing-comment value reads hook-missing, and never names the match selector rule
findingDetails.claim: README.markdown:235 says a value with a trailing comment or a single-quoted string reads hook-missing, but the fix accepts both shapes for a match value, so the sentence is false for match and no describing doc names the absent-or-main selector rule.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the entry regex at :263 to see whether type and command also gained comment tolerance; they did not, so the sentence remains true for those keys and false only for match.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence could be read as scoped to the values the reader refuses; it does not say so, and the same row is the operator's only account of the Vibe reading.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the false sentence is directly observable. If a later doc adds the selector rule, only the first clause remains.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The README is the describing doc for the in-scope doctor script; the script comments at :232-234 and :377-378 state the selector rule the README omits.
affectedSurfaceHints: operator repair path for hook-missing vibe

findingDetails.title: The new names-the-main-agent case duplicates the default case, so it cannot fail for a reason of its own
findingDetails.claim: vibeBlock defaults to match = "main", so the case at :249-255 writes byte-identical TOML to :241-247 and asserts the same exit code and line; it adds no distinct branch.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Compared the two rendered blocks and the helper default; also checked whether the new case exercises a different quoting shape or an explicit-versus-default distinction, and it does not.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The case may be intended as documentation of the explicit selector; as written it cannot distinguish an explicit selector from the default one.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: None; the duplicate is a direct read. If the helper default changes, the two cases diverge and the finding lapses.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both cases and the helper are in the in-scope test file; the absent and non-main branches are already covered by :257-271 and :273-303.

spec_code.notes: REQ-007's doctor item holds by fixture and by the repository run; its doc item covers the hook contract, not the doctor README, so C5B-P2-001 is a describing-doc gap.

agent_cross_runtime.notes: The check's five runtime rows are unchanged apart from the Vibe selector rule, and the repository run prints ok for all five.
